text:
Marta: FYI opened a short PR that clarifies eviction grace periods and adds a small rollback example for Dedicated provisioning. Need one or two reviewers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1754
Jonah: Thanks — pinging for review. Which files touched?
Marta: docs/dedicated/provisioning.md and docs/dedicated/migration-checklist.md. Added a note about `eviction_grace_seconds` and a small kubectl rollback snippet.
Priya: Can you paste the key snippet here? I'll check the wording about 'guarantees' and SLA overlap.
Marta: Snippet below (yaml example we added):
```yaml
apiVersion: rwinference/v1
kind: ReservedPool
metadata:
  name: analytics-pool
spec:
  reserved_capacity_type: reserved
  autoscale:
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 10
    target_concurrency_per_gpu: 12
  isolation:
    eviction_grace_seconds: 300   # 5 minutes grace to allow in-flight requests to finish
    eviction_priority: protected
```
Marta: And a rollback example (kubectl) we suggested for the migration checklist:
```bash
# revert a bad config rollout
kubectl rollout undo deployment/reserved-pool-controller -n redwood-system
# verify pods are back to previous replica count
kubectl get pods -l app=reserved-pool-controller -n redwood-system
```
Alex: The yaml key name `eviction_grace_seconds` is new; make sure it's listed in the spec reference table and that the default value is documented (default: 120s).
Priya: Also add a sentence in the SLA section: "Eviction grace periods improve request completion but do not extend platform SLA commitments" — we should avoid implying extended latency guarantees.
Jonah: Agree. Add a short example sentence: "To minimize disruption during migration, set min_replicas conservatively and use eviction_grace_seconds >= 180 for long-running requests."
Marta: Will update. One more ask: can someone confirm the controller supports rollback command above? I tested in staging and it worked.
Alex: Confirmed rollback command exists; left a tiny inline comment in the PR about namespace name.
DocsBot: Spellcheck passed. Lint: 1 warning (line length in code comment).
Priya: Approved after Marta adjusts SLA wording and documents default.
Jonah: Approved.
Marta: Merged and created a follow-up issue to add API reference entry for `eviction_grace_seconds`: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/440
BuildBot: Docs site build started for merged PR. Preview will be posted shortly.
Alex: Thanks all — nice small improvement for migration hygiene.
Marta: Closing thread; will watch preview for rendering quirks.
